rationale: Vehicle damage from a motor-vehicle collision with clear third-party liability; the policyholder's vehicle was struck by another vehicle.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan's vehicle was totaled in a rear-end collision on Route 9 yesterday at 8:15 AM when struck by another vehicle at approximately 35 mph with no braking; the policyholder sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. The at-fault driver's insurance information is documented on the police report. This is a high-severity claim requiring urgent adjuster attention for vehicle damage assessment and injury evaluation.

case_facts.description: Rear-ended at red light by other vehicle traveling ~35 mph with no braking; entire trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.vehicle_damage: Vehicle totaled; trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.other_driver_at_fault: Yes; other driver's insurance info on police report
